items.acceptance_evidence: Fix commit b202d8f57e (2026-06-15) replaces the bare constructors with a generic not-found message; the author's thread reply names this sha and explains keeping ids out of the response body to preserve the non-leak posture.
items.description: Three throw sites in the new read service use bare `new NotFoundException()` with no message or context, against the repo's authored API rule that mandates a message plus contextual identifiers. A production 404 here carries no entry/transcript id, so the three distinct failure modes (no timeline entry, null entity id, missing transcript row) are indistinguishable in logs. Sibling services in the same domain pass a message object.

items.acceptance_evidence: Fix commit b202d8f57e (2026-06-15) routes the transcript path through the same projected entity-manager lookup as the summary path and drops the injected full-row service; the author's thread reply names this sha.
items.description: Within one service, the transcript body path loads the row via another module's service method that hydrates the full entity (including unused columns), while the summary path reads the same cross-module table via a projected entity-manager findOne with an explicit fields list. Two access mechanisms for one table in one service blur the module-isolation boundary and over-fetch on the body path; both reads should go through a single, projected boundary.

items.acceptance_evidence: Fix commit b202d8f57e (2026-06-15) reseeds the non-meeting entry against a granted beneficiary, adds a control assertion that the row is visible via the timeline route, and re-verifies the non-leak 404s; the author's thread reply names this sha.
items.description: The IDOR test for the source-type filter passes vacuously: the seeded non-meeting row is attached to an ungranted user, so the asserted 404 is produced by row-level security (the caller has no grant), not by the source filter under test — deleting the source condition from the query would leave the test green. The seed must grant the caller access to the row so only the source filter can produce the 404, plus a control asserting the same id is readable via its real route.

items.acceptance_evidence: Fix commit b202d8f57e (2026-06-15) adds a retry button wired to the query refetch, with component-test coverage; the author's thread reply names this sha.
items.description: On a non-404 transcript load error the UI renders copy telling the user to 'try again', but no retry control exists: once the transcript view is toggled on, the load button is gone, and closing and reopening the dialog refetches only the summary, not the transcript. Either wire a retry control to the transcript query's refetch or drop the try-again wording.

items.acceptance_evidence: Fix commit b202d8f57e (2026-06-15) rewords the null-summary state to a still-being-generated message with component coverage; the author's thread reply names this sha.
items.description: Two near-identical empty states differ by one word: a generated-but-null summary renders 'not available yet' while a summary 404 renders 'not available', even though the states differ materially (the 404 path also drops the metadata header). Easy to conflate in QA. The transient null path should read as in-progress, e.g. that the summary is still being generated.

items.acceptance_evidence: Fix commit b202d8f57e (2026-06-15) tightens the field to a non-empty-string array and adds DTO test coverage for the empty-attendee case; the author's thread reply names this sha.
items.description: The response DTO types an email-shaped attendees field as a bare string array, while the repo's authored schema-validation rule discourages bare strings for known formats. Since display names are planned for a later slice, full email validation would be premature, but the elements should at least reject empty strings (min length 1) until the looser union is actually needed.
